description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2940015599941 FILTER ELEMENT,INTA: Line 0001 Qty 72 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0084 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
